The paper develops central-DP analogues of Assouad, Fano, and Le Cam through distribution couplings for lower bounds.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies epsilon-DP selection from a finite hypothesis class of size m, with logarithmic dependence on class size in its finite-selection guarantees.
The paper introduces a DP CATE meta-algorithm using sample splitting and parallel composition for S-, DR-, and R-learners; it does not state a pointwise Hölder minimax frontier.
Theorem 1 gives an observational finite-query CATE release with Gaussian vector noise under (epsilon,delta)-DP; Theorem 3 gives a Gaussian-process functional release under approximate DP.
